topics.name: Canonical Contract Semantic Validation
topics.purpose: Define validation of ownership, identity uniqueness, references, relations, dependency semantics, invariants, hard gates and cross-contract constraints after structural validation.

semantics.identity_rule: Canonical identities are globally unique within the active source set unless explicit multi-revision semantics applies.
semantics.reference_rule: Required refs resolve exactly and type-compatibly.
semantics.ownership_rule: Ownership declarations do not conflict without explicit composition/override semantics.
semantics.constraint_rule: Invariants/hard gates are machine-significant validation semantics.
semantics.cross_rule: Cross-contract semantic rules are evaluated over the whole accepted candidate graph.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.

hard_gates.condition: ownership conflict resolved by file order
semantic validation limited to one file

references.purpose: Semantic validation includes exact reference integrity.
